about: E34 Amendment 10, 2026-11-02. The comparison of Amendment 9, weighted by the inputs the model sees: option (a) of log card decision-commute-settled, the user's choice. The user's question: does the claim read 'copies the fine-tune's change on real inputs' or 'reproduces its behaviour by a different change'? This job measures one thing towards it: is a student's weight change as close to its fine-tune's as a rerun of that fine-tune is, in angle and in length, at each matrix's output on these inputs. what_each_outcome_allows says, per family, what the claim may then say. Plan reports/plans/2026-11-02_plan_e34-amend10-input-weighted.md. Saved states, one forward of W0 and the reruns, one free cluster job. Filed before the run. Stage 0 alone (Frobenius, no model, no input) and the read path on made-up moments were run before filing; expected.frobenius_known_before_filing has the only real numbers. Nothing weighted by inputs has been read. Design check: approved by the user; class 1, analysis of what exists.
request_in_the_terms_words: For each saved student of a teacher training, its weight change S = (U + dU)(V + dV)^T - U V^T from W0's alive (U, V), and its fine-tune's finished update dW. For two changes A, B the inner product is, over the 24 matrices together, sum_k tr(A_k Sigma_k B_k^T) = E sum_k <A_k x, B_k x>, x the input matrix k sees and Sigma_k = E[x x^T]. Read the cosine of S with dW under it, S's size and its distance from dW in dW's lengths, and beside them, against the same dW: the reruns of the same fine-tune, a different task's fine-tune and the same table's other seed's student.

states.students: Eight: E12 Amendment 2's rand32_s0, rand32_s1, rand32b_s0, rand32b_s0_o1, rand32b_s1, rand32b_s1_o1 (new_vs_existing/results/large/amend2/); Amendment 8c's real_o0, real_o1 (amend8/amend8c/). U, V: amend8c/uv0.pt. In this code E12's students are named S_<name>, because E12 named a student after its fine-tune. Amendment 9's two null students are left out: no rule reads them.
states.fine_tunes: Saved: regating_table/results/large/{rand32,rand32b}_{s0,s1}.pt (rand32 step 10, rand32b step 30, fp32), amend8c/{real,null}_teacher_dW.pt (Adam 3e-5, steps 1,000 and 100, bf16). The null fine-tune is a different task's reference only.
states.reruns: Trained in this job and saved in results/large/amend10/: real_teacher_o1, real_teacher_o2 (bf16); rand32_s2, rand32_s3, rand32b_s2, rand32b_s3 at each table's own step; rand32_long_s0, rand32_long_s1 at 1,000 steps, the length reference.

inputs.model: W0's activations for every read, whichever pair. One fixed x for both sides: then there is one inner product, each cosine is symmetric, and every reference is read in the same metric. Neither the student's nor the fine-tuned model's own activations are favoured, W0 is where (U, V) and Gamma were fitted, and the reads are first order in the change, so the change in x is second order. Blind to that second-order part
inputs.task: task:<t>: every position of the task's held-out windows: 73 windows on emoticon, 97 on each map table, 41 positions each, held out of both the fine-tune's and the student's training. Text around the trigger, with the trigger 1 position in 41
inputs.trigger: trigger:<t>: position `half` alone of the same windows, where the taught behaviour is read. Sigma has rank at most the window count, 73 or 97, against d_in 768 or 3072, so its noise is high; P4 reads it and it does not enter the reading. It leaves out the k and v inputs of earlier positions that attention reads at the trigger. The emoticon held-out set has 4 distinct trigger tokens against 10 in training
inputs.taught: taught:<t>: Sigma_trigger + Sigma_task, the training's own weighting (finetune.arm_a_weighting: the trigger term plus the mean of every other position), from the two sets' saved Grams, with no new forward. Full rank where the task set is. Sigma_task still holds the trigger at 1 position in 41, a difference of about 1/41 from the training's exact weighting, stated and not removed. P5 reads it and it does not enter the reading, which is scoped to say so
inputs.pile: pile: every position of Pile val rows 0 to 255, the harness's rows (faithfulness.pile_blocks), 131,072 positions
inputs.reads: `model(rows, cache_type='input').cache`, as vpd.compute_ci reads it, with no autocast (weight_side.inputs_and_gates's form), fp32 forward, x x^T and every matrix product in fp64. The reruns alone train, under the recipe's bf16 autocast
inputs.mean: Uncentred is the request's own inner product: a constant output shift is real behaviour downstream. Centred, Sigma - mu mu^T, is read beside it, and the verdicts need both to agree, so a result the mean alone carries reads 'mixed' and goes to 'cannot tell'
inputs.normalisation: Over all matrices together, as Amendment 9. Per-matrix inner products are saved in results/large/amend10/gram_<set>.pt and read by no rule. top_matrix_share, written per fine-tune and set, is said beside a reading when above 0.5
inputs.layout: The 67M's 24 matrices are nn.Linear, (d_out, d_in); `vpd.target_linear` asserts it, so there is no Conv1D here. S and dW share that layout: Amendment 9's check read the transposed layout at most 0.0013. The layout control below tests x against the module

measurements.cos: <A, B>_Sigma / sqrt(<A, A>_Sigma <B, B>_Sigma), absolute. Per input set, per form (uncentred, centred), per part (whole, windows of alternate source rows in halves A and B). Read: `S | dW` own; `dW' | dW` a rerun; other fine-tune against dW; other seed's student against dW
measurements.size: ||S||_Sigma / ||dW||_Sigma, and the same for each rerun, from the Gram. Reported, whole set. Read beside a length verdict: given an angle read as close, a further distance comes from size alone
measurements.dist: ||S - dW||_Sigma / ||dW||_Sigma, and the same for each rerun, per part, from the Gram. A zero change is at exactly 1. dist^2 = size^2 - 2 size cos + 1
measurements.rerun_line: The mean over every ordered pair of a family's runs, in cosine or in distance: real_teacher, real_teacher_o1, real_teacher_o2 on the real task (six ordered, three distinct cosines); s0 to s3 of a table on a map table (twelve ordered, six distinct). One line per table, form and input set
measurements.margin: Per family, kind of input and form, in cosine (m) and separately in distance (m_d): the largest of the least margin (gap_min, gap_dist_min), the largest |A - B| over every cell the family's rules read (each pair of its runs, its students, every other-task fine-tune, the other seed's students), the largest batch-order change (rand32b's two seeds' students on the map tables, real_o0 against real_o1 on the real task), one bf16 rounding draw, and the range over its reruns. Split by w.row: a source row's windows stay in one half, so the halves share no text. On emoticon 13 of the 49 rows hold more than one window. Conservative: |A - B| compares two half-size samples, against reads on the whole set
measurements.ceiling: Per fine-tune with students, set and form: sqrt(1 - outside-both share), the outside-both block (GOALS.md, split.four_blocks; (I - P_U) dW a2) pooled over the matrices on this Sigma. A first-order change of the alive subcomponents reads at most this cosine with dW and no nearer than sqrt(1 - ceiling^2), and reaches both (tests/test_teacher_amend10.py, by construction and on 50 random first-order changes). Students are first order to 5 decimals by Amendment 9's span check. By Frobenius on the saved states it reads 0.787 to 0.816, with every student under it. Unread on inputs
measurements.concentration: top_matrix_share, written per fine-tune and set: the largest single matrix's share of E||dW x||^2, uncentred. mean_share is read by the analysis from gram_<set>.pt
measurements.frobenius: The same cosines with Sigma = I, for comparison and the re-read control
measurements.spectrum: k/d per matrix on each task-windows set and Pile: the share of read directions with an eigenvalue at or above excite_eps x their mean, in controls.power <set>.k_over_d
measurements.length_reference: One map table (rand32) at 1,000 steps, seeds 0 and 1: the pair's cosine on task windows and Pile, beside the table's own-length line (step 10) and the real task's line (1,000 steps), in score.length_reference. A reference only: read by no rule

the_inside_part: Not read as a cosine. Under this inner product the Frobenius inside part is not orthogonal to the rest; the input-weighted inside is the complement of the outside-both block, read as the ceiling

predictions.rule: Per E12 student s against its own fine-tune r, on task windows and on Pile, each uncentred and centred. own = cos(S, r); rerun = r's table's line; other_task = the largest of cos(f, r) over the other table's two saved fine-tunes, the real and the null; ceiling = r's ceiling on this set and form; m the margin. angle_label: anything not finite 'unscorable'. Refused, 'cannot tell': rerun under rerun_floor; rerun - other_task under 2 m; ceiling under rerun - gap_min. Else `close`: own >= rerun - gap_min is 'as close as a rerun', unless m is over 2 gap_min, 'cannot tell'; own < rerun - m is 'further than a rerun'; otherwise 'cannot tell'. Lines inclusive as written. length_label, the same in distance: anything not finite 'unscorable'; rerun distance over 1 or sqrt(1 - ceiling^2) over rerun distance + gap_dist_min, 'cannot tell'; dist <= rerun distance + gap_dist_min is 'as close as a rerun', unless m_d is over 2 gap_dist_min, 'cannot tell'; dist > rerun distance + m_d is 'further than a rerun'; otherwise 'cannot tell'. A verdict per input kind and axis over all six students and both forms: one label if all agree, 'unscorable' if any is, else 'mixed'; the same per table in by_table, as a split between the tables is a live outcome. `reading` per axis, task windows with Pile: any 'unscorable' 'unscorable'; any not a decided label 'cannot tell'; both alike that label; decided and different 'depends on the inputs'
predictions.lean: Angle 'further than a rerun', medium-low: students read 0.30 to 0.41 by Frobenius against reruns of 0.61 and 0.68; a student was trained on outputs, so input weighting should raise its read more than a rerun's; how far is the open number. Length 'further than a rerun', medium: by Frobenius students sit at 1.5 to 2.3 times the fine-tune's size and 1.42 to 2.20 from it, reruns at 0.80 to 0.90. Second lean on task windows 'cannot tell', if the margins are large
predictions.blind_to: What downstream layers do with each matrix's output: a difference there may matter or cancel later, and whether behaviour is kept is not read at all. First order: S and dW are read on W0's x. Pooling: a large-output matrix counts more; top_matrix_share shows if one carries it. A cosine ignores size, which the length axis reads; the distance mixes angle and size, which the size ratio separates. A rerun differs from a fine-tune in batch order alone: the_rerun.limits_on_comparing
predictions.positive_control: As-close branch: the ceiling, the best first-order change's own reads, which must reach the line or the label is 'cannot tell'. Further branch: another task's fine-tune must sit 2 m under the line. Weighting: the power control
predictions.noise_floor: The margins, stated per family, input kind and form in score.by_input

predictions.rule: The same two labels, verdicts and reading, per real_o0, real_o1 against the real fine-tune. rerun = the line over real_teacher, real_teacher_o1, real_teacher_o2; other_task = the largest of cos(f, real) over the four saved map fine-tunes and the null. Its own margins
predictions.lean: Angle 'further than a rerun', medium-low: own 0.27, 0.28 by Frobenius; the rerun unread, and E53's cipher at 300 steps reads 0.84. Length 'further than a rerun', medium-low: by Frobenius the students sit at 0.73 times the size and 1.06 from the fine-tune, further than no change
predictions.positive_control: As P1, on the real fine-tune. The recipe's order 0 against the saved teacher

predictions.rule: seed_class per E12 student against its own fine-tune, same reads and forms as P1, on task windows and Pile. others = the same table's other seed's students against that fine-tune. Not finite or no others: 'unscorable'. `close` with the largest other as the read and own as the line: within gap_min of own, 'follows the task only', unless m is over 2 gap_min, 'cannot tell'; under own by more than m, 'follows its own run'; otherwise 'cannot tell'. By agree per input kind
predictions.lean: 'cannot tell' or 'mixed', medium-low: by Frobenius own against other seed is 0.05 to 0.07, about the least margin
predictions.blind_to: Two seeds per table. Not read on the real task: no student of its rerun exists
predictions.positive_control: None of its own: all paths are tested on made-up reads

predictions.rule: P1's and P2's labels on trigger:<t>, with the trigger's margins and the same forms. Pile has no trigger, so verdicts per family and axis only
predictions.lean: 'cannot tell', medium: Sigma has rank at most 73 or 97, so split halves of about 36 to 48 inputs should give a large margin
predictions.blind_to: As P1, and the earlier positions' k and v inputs
predictions.positive_control: The ceiling on this Sigma; the power control's on the same task's windows

predictions.rule: P1's and P2's labels on taught:<t>, Sigma_trigger + Sigma_task, with its own margins and the same forms
predictions.lean: The same labels as task windows, low: the trigger's energy may dominate where it is large
predictions.blind_to: As P1. About 1/41 from the training's exact weighting, inputs.taught

what_each_outcome_allows.half_not_read: This job reads the change, not the behaviour. Whether the behaviour is kept is read elsewhere and only cited: on the real task, E34 (Amendment 8's 0.0286 nats from the fine-tuned model). On the map tables, E12 Amendment 2: rand32's students keep their gain (ratio 1.02) and move the re-switching term by 2%; rand32b's keep their gain (ratio 0.98) and lose about a fifth of the re-switching term (1.02 to 1.23 of 5.8 to 6.0 nats), cause unknown. So 'reproduces its behaviour' can't be claimed for rand32b as it stands, whichever way this job reads
what_each_outcome_allows.as_close_means: With r = T + n, r' = T + n', a student of exactly T reads sqrt(rerun) and one of T plus a noise of the same size reads rerun. So 'as close as a rerun' is at the level of another run, not an identical change. 'Further than a rerun' means only that: a cosine of 0.70 against a line of 0.80 reads further

real_task.angle and length as close, on task windo: The claim may read: the decomposition after teacher training copies the fine-tune's change on real inputs, at the level of a rerun, at each matrix's output; with E34, it keeps the behaviour too.
real_task.angle as close, length further: It points as a rerun does and its size differs by the reported ratio. The claim may read 'copies the direction of the fine-tune's change on real inputs, at a different size'; not 'copies' alone.
real_task.angle further: The claim may read: reproduces its behaviour (E34, not this job) by a change further from the fine-tune's than a rerun is, at the reported cosine and distance. 'Different change' may be used only with that meaning. Whether the differences cancel downstream is unread.
real_task.angle 'cannot tell': Behaviour kept (E34), and the change on inputs not resolved, with the reason (floor, references, ceiling, or noise). Neither half of the user's sentence on the change is claimed. The line can still close, stating that.
real_task.'depends on the inputs': The two inputs' labels are stated, each with its own sentence as above. No single wording.

map_tables.angle and length as close, on task windo: For rand32: copies the fine-tune's change on real inputs, at the level of a 10-step rerun, with its behaviour kept by E12 Amendment 2. For rand32b: the same at 30 steps for the change alone, with the fifth of the re-switching term stated as lost. With P3 'follows the task only': the task's change, not this run's.
map_tables.angle as close, length further: It points as a rerun does, at the reported size (students by Frobenius are 1.5 to 2.3 times the fine-tune's size). 'Copies the direction', not 'copies'.
map_tables.angle further: For rand32: reproduces its behaviour (E12 Amendment 2, not this job) by a change further from the fine-tune's than a rerun is. For rand32b: further than a rerun, keeps its gain, and loses about a fifth of the re-switching term; 'reproduces its behaviour' is not available.
map_tables.angle 'cannot tell', or 'mixed' with by_: The per-table labels are stated. 'Cannot tell' alone: the change on inputs is not resolved, with the reason.

what_each_outcome_allows.either_family: Each sentence carries its scope: at each matrix's output on W0's inputs, on every position of held-out windows and of Pile, not about the trigger. If P4 or P5 decides against the reading, the report says the sentence does not hold there: the behaviour is taught at the trigger. No sentence joins the two families. Their reruns differ in length, map tables 10 and 30 steps, the real task 1,000; a difference between families can't by itself be read as task rather than length. The 1,000-step map-table pair reports how one table's rerun cosine moves with length, on one pair. It does not replace the own-length reruns, since those students' teachers are 10- and 30-step, and no rule reads it

controls.first_and_alone: Stage 0, no model: the Frobenius re-read of every pair in amend9.json within ctrl_tol; every vector against itself 1 within ctrl_tol; the zero change reads nan on its row. Then, before any input set: the layout control, then the reruns; stage 0 again with them in. Then every set's moments, then every power control, before any Gram of a student. Per input set, before its reads are written: a positive smallest diagonal. Any miss stops the job. So a control stop comes before any input-weighted read of a student, on every set
controls.layout: On 4 windows at W0 + the real dW: the module's output against x (W0 + dW)^T, x from the input cache, relative error at most layout_tol on all 24 matrices. It tests that the cache holds what each matrix sees, and that dW's layout fits it
controls.power: For one fine-tune per set (real on emoticon and Pile, <t>_s0 on each map table), per matrix: the directions with an eigenvalue under excite_eps x their mean are 'not excited'. Z = dW + R, R random on those directions, ||R||^2 = rho2 ||dW||^2. cos_Sigma(Z, dW) >= 0.99 and cos_Frobenius(Z, dW) <= 0.5, or stop. It says only that Sigma is ill-conditioned enough for the weighting to differ from Frobenius; the ceiling is the control that bears on a verdict. On an isotropic Sigma no direction goes unexcited and the Frobenius side fails, as tests show. Not run on the trigger sets, where low rank passes it trivially. The review's estimate of the first filing's cumulative rule: it would probably have stopped the job
controls.ceiling: The as-close branch's positive control, per student: the best first-order change must reach the line, or the label is 'cannot tell', since a 'further' would then be by construction
controls.do_nothing: The weight change dW itself reads 1 against dW by the arithmetic: tested, and read by Frobenius in stage 0
controls.reruns: Each recipe at its saved seed runs first and alone: 1 - cos_Frobenius to the saved fine-tune at most saved_tol, for rand32_s0, rand32b_s0 and the real teacher. The real recipe: held-out P(target) at least t_p_min at orders 0, 1, 2. Stop if not, before any read. Each is timed and reported with its eval; size has no stop

expected.W0: No change, S = 0: the zero denominator; cos, size and distance nan, by arithmetic tested on the Gram; every rule 'unscorable'. Stage 0 reads this as its zero row and stops if not. A centred diagonal at or under 0 reads nan the same way
expected.do-nothing: cos 1 and distance 0 against dW, on every Sigma, as dW | dW in the reads
expected.power control: cos_Sigma about 0.996, at least 0.99, if dW's read side is not concentrated where Sigma is small; 0.9973 on the made-up spectrum in the dry run. cos_Frobenius about 1/3, at most 0.5: it fails only if under 3/8 of dW's energy sits on matrices with a direction not excited. k/d lean 0.7 to 0.995, from the review's fits, low confidence: the real spectrum is unread
expected.frobenius_known_before_filing: Stage 0's dry run on this code, 2026-11-02, cpu-run: against amend9.json within 1e-12. Rerun by Frobenius, whole update: rand32 0.605, rand32b 0.675. Own: rand32 0.298, 0.320, rand32b 0.391 to 0.412, real 0.274, 0.281. Size and distance from the fine-tune: rand32 students 2.28, 2.18 to 2.20; rand32b 1.50 to 1.54, 1.42 to 1.47; real 0.73, 1.06. Reruns: size 0.98 to 1.02, distance 0.80 to 0.90. Ceiling by Frobenius: real 0.787, rand32 0.814, 0.816, rand32b 0.813, 0.814, each above its students
expected.reruns_on_inputs: Lean 0.6 to 0.95 on task windows and Pile, above Frobenius, low confidence: reruns share a gradient that inputs drive. Above the 0.5 floor on Pile, medium. Rerun spread 0 to 0.05
expected.own_on_inputs: Lean 0.3 to 0.8, above Frobenius, low confidence
expected.other_task_on_inputs: Lean 0 to 0.4, low: the mean part may raise it
expected.ceiling_on_inputs: Lean about 0.93 or higher, from the fine-tune's outside-both of 0.055 to 0.131 on one earlier Sigma (2026-10-20_analysis_lora-split.md, 20 non-saturated matrices); centred unread. Own at or under it, up to the students' second-order term, lean within 1e-3
expected.length_reference: The 1,000-step pair's cosine above its 10-step line on Pile, lean 0.7 to 0.95, low: E53's cipher rerun rose with length by Frobenius, 0.14, 0.42, 0.84 at 10, 100, 300
expected.margins: Task windows: split-half 0.01 to 0.2, low confidence, about 36 to 48 windows per half and the other-task cells in the max. So 'as close' on task windows may be barred by the cap, which reads 'cannot tell', the right answer on these few windows. Pile: under 0.02, so gap_min rules there unless the rerun spread exceeds it. Batch order: Amendment 9's largest 0.025 on the inside-part cosine, 0.020 on the whole by Frobenius; 0.028 in distance. Trigger: 0.1 or more
expected.rounding: One draw under 0.01. Sigma weights directions unequally, so rounding could count for more here than Frobenius's 2e-6 if S or dW is small along Sigma's top directions; hence a measured draw
expected.time: About 14 min on an L40, 30 min asked. Measured in the dry run on 8 of the worker's CPUs on real vectors with made-up moments: load 8 s, stage 0 3 s, bases 8 s, one power control 12 s, one read_set (Grams, ceilings) 43 to 56 s, one taught read 13 s. fp64 on the card is unmeasured, so the Grams are budgeted at these CPU times. Per stage: load and stage 0, 0.5 min; model and layout, 0.5 min (23 s logged, E12 Amendment 3); reruns, 3.5 min (five 1,000-step fine-tunes at 35 s logged, six short at about 3 s); bases, moments and 7 forward sets, 2 min (Pile's 32 batches unmeasured, the largest unknown); four power controls, 1 min; reads of 7 sets at about 50 s and 3 taught at 13 s, 6.5 min. Over 30 min the job is killed with its files kept, each set written as it finishes; `score` runs on the file's reads
expected.reruns: Order 0 reproduces 8c's numbers on an L40: cos about 1 less bf16 rounding, P(target) 0.99910, size 0.0315, damage 0.0554, size at step 1 0.00346. Orders 1 and 2: P(target) above 0.9946, size within Amendment 8's 0.0301 to 0.0341 and step 1 within a few percent of 0.00346, lean. Map tables at seed 0 reproduce their saved fine-tunes, P(target) 0.585 on rand32; seeds 2, 3 P(target) about 0.54 to 0.58, lean, with no stop

noise_floors: Sampling: split-half by alternate source row; its |A - B| goes into the margin. Batch order: rand32b's two seeds' students and real's pair. bf16: real_o1's saved offsets and the real dW each moved by one draw, uniform within +-2^-8 relative, an upper bound on one rounding, read as |cos(moved) - cos(saved)| on the same Sigma. The reruns' range. Second moment: fp32 activations, x x^T summed in fp64, every product in fp64. No autocast, so no bf16 in x. Least margins gap_min, gap_dist_min

threshold_sources.layout_tol: fp32 forward of outputs; three orders above measured fp32 rounding of a product. A wrong layout reads near 1
threshold_sources.rerun_floor: Arithmetic: a rerun of equal length at cosine 0.5 is at distance exactly 1, as far from dW as no change at all (distance^2 = 2 - 2 cos). Under it, 'as close as a rerun' is no closer than nothing. In the shared-part picture, rerun = |T|^2 / (|T|^2 + |n|^2): at 0.5 a run is half task and half batches. Replaces along_min 0.1, under which the review's 0.16 read 'copies'. Rerun distance over 1 is the same floor on the length axis
threshold_sources.gap_min: As close: own and the line may each move by Amendment 9's largest batch-order change, 0.025 (its report: the cosine to the inside part, 0.001 to 0.025; 0.020 on the whole), so they may read 2 x 0.025 apart with no real difference
threshold_sources.gap_dist_min: The same arithmetic on this distance: the largest batch-order change by Frobenius on the saved states, 0.028 (rand32b_s1, 1.4512 against 1.4233; rand32b_s0 0.017; real 0.006), twice that. Measured for this filing, scratch t_gap.py
threshold_sources.noise cap, 2 x gap: Noise can't give the first label. A larger m can't lower the as-close line, which is gap, not m. And a read inside the band with m over 2 gap reads 'cannot tell': whole = (A + B) / 2, so |A - B| is about twice a whole read's noise, and at the cap that noise is at most the band's width. Arithmetic
threshold_sources.2 m gate: Arithmetic: own >= rerun - m must imply own at least m above other_task, so a label can't be read at a student indistinguishable from another task's fine-tune
threshold_sources.excite_eps, rho2, power_sigma_min, power: Control design, from the brief's 'near 1' and 'low': the review's fix. With rho2 8 the Frobenius read is 1/3 if every matrix has a direction not excited; the Sigma-energy ratio is at most about rho2 x eps = 0.008, so cos_Sigma about 0.996; 0.99 and 0.5 leave room
threshold_sources.round_rel: Amendment 9's min_share source: bf16 rounding is at most 2^-8 of an entry
threshold_sources.the reruns as the line, in place of 0.71: The independent check of Amendment 9: the 0.71 line fails even a rerun of the same fine-tune
threshold_sources.saved_tol: Amendment 8c's saved_tol, a regeneration on the same card against a saved cosine. All compute cards are L40
threshold_sources.t_p_min: Amendment 8's filed AM.t_p lower bound for T1000. The saved teacher reads 0.99910

the_rerun.recipe: Real: amend8.real_teacher, as Amendment 8c ran it: finetune.finetune_arm_a, ArmAConfig(o_token = windows.json's o_token_id, lr 3e-5, steps 1,000, checkpoints (1, 1,000), optimizer adam), defaults batch 32, clip 1, kl_lambda 1; transport_test's train and held-out windows; bf16 autocast in the forward, as the fine-tune ran; saved bf16. the_rerun.what_it_varies: The batch-order seed alone: the torch.Generator behind torch.randint over the training windows. Weights, windows, target, optimizer and length are the same
the_rerun.differences_from_the_saved_teacher: Batch order, which is the point. Beyond it, none intended. Amendment 8c's job ran the W0 Pile harness first and went through harness.load; neither touches the local generator, the model is in eval mode, and _run restores W0. finetune.py last changed at e9d445d7, before 8c's files. The recipes at their saved seeds run first and must reproduce the saved fine-tunes; that control tests all of these
the_rerun.limits_on_comparing: Length differs between families, not within them. A map-table rerun is at 10 or 30 steps, the real one at 1,000. At 10 steps a seed changes which windows are drawn at all (320 draws from 403), at 1,000 every window is seen about 88 times (32,000 draws from 365), so the seed may leave less difference and the real rerun may read higher. Map-table fine-tunes stop at first learned (held-out P(target) about 0.54 to 0.58), the real one at 0.999. Map students trained 1,000 steps against a 10- or 30-step fine-tune, real ones 1,000 against 1,000. So each student is read against its own family's rerun, and no sentence joins the families. The 1,000-step map-table pair is a reference for how a rerun's cosine moves with length, on one table and one pair: those students' teachers are 10- and 30-step, so it does not replace their own-length reruns. Batches: real_o0 shares all 1,000 with the fine-tune; real_o1 with a rerun, which is one of the line's three runs; both must agree, so a read inflated by shared batches can't carry a label alone
